fields.key_terms: Provider shall perform the services described in each Statement of Work signed by both parties, with the skill and care of a qualified professional.
fields.payment_terms: Client shall pay Provider the fees set out in each Statement of Work. Provider will invoice monthly, and Client shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.
fields.termination_clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 30 days' written notice, or immediately if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and does not cure the breach within 15 days of written notice.

fields.key_terms: Consultant shall provide data and reporting advisory services as requested by Company and shall not subcontract any work without written consent.
fields.payment_terms: Company shall pay Consultant $110 per hour, invoiced monthly and payable within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date.
fields.termination_clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 60 days' written notice, or immediately if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and does not cure the breach within 30 days of written notice.

fields.key_terms: Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the software for internal business purposes on up to 250 named users.
fields.payment_terms: Licensee shall pay an annual license fee of $12,000, due within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date and of each anniversary.
fields.termination_clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 90 days' written notice, or immediately if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and does not cure the breach within 15 days of written notice.

fields.key_terms: Landlord leases to Tenant approximately 4,800 square feet of office space for general office use, with access to shared parking.
fields.payment_terms: Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $4,600, due on the first day of each month, and a security deposit equal to two months' rent on signing.
fields.termination_clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 60 days' written notice, or immediately if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and does not cure the breach within 15 days of written notice.

fields.key_terms: Supplier shall deliver the products listed in Schedule A within ten (10) business days of each purchase order, packaged to prevent damage in transit.
fields.payment_terms: Buyer shall pay for each delivery at the unit prices in Schedule A within forty-five (45) days of the invoice date.
fields.termination_clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 90 days' written notice, or immediately if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and does not cure the breach within 30 days of written notice.
